name: g67_residual_leftovers_tie
purpose: Step G67 regression, the residual tie of two equally fast Leftovers holders (mechanism 1 of campaign seed 6700000 battle 10, a follow-on error of the hit-loop Update). Both sides lead with Milotic (Leftovers, Scald, Protect) and Staraptor; no Substitute and no weather (Tyranitar is benched). The Milotic take the Staraptors' Brave Bird each turn and heal at every residual, and their Leftovers callbacks tie in speed; then Protect on the next turn.
